title: Amend epic pwp's acceptance criteria to match the reviewed keeps before closing the epic
body: pwp.json still says the 'factory and cloud commands' are gone, but the integrated branch deliberately keeps six `tk cloud` D19 operator verbs (branch/spawn/wait/collect/prbody/reconcile), documented in cloud.go's own help text and accepted by the sx5 review. g69 covers the analogous literal-criterion gap for cloud/sandbox; nothing covers this one. Whoever closes pwp should amend the criterion or the claim so the epic record does not assert a deletion the reviewed diff intentionally did not make.
